h1: Between Rounds: Non-Golf & Family Activities at Villa Espada
body_markdown:
Punta Espada is why most groups come to Villa Espada. But a golf trip is not 18 hours of golf a day — and a family reunion or multi-generational trip needs more than tee times. So what does everyone actually do between rounds, on rest days, or when the non-golfers want their own fun?

Quite a lot, as it turns out. Villa Espada is stocked for every kind of group, on the property itself — no golf cart required.

## A Private Putting Green — On the Property

Villa Espada has its own private putting green, on the villa grounds. Warm up your stroke before you head to Punta Espada, settle a friendly putting contest after dinner, or let the kids have a go. It is a rare feature even among luxury Cap Cana villas, and for a golf group it is the kind of detail that turns downtime into more golf.

## The Outdoor Games Area

The outdoor games area is where a lot of the between-rounds competition happens. It includes:

- A **full-size outdoor pool table**
- An **outdoor ping pong table**
- **Cornhole (bags)**
- A **giant chess board**
- **Giant Connect Four**
- **Lawn darts**

It is enough to run an afternoon tournament, keep teenagers busy, or settle who buys the first round at dinner. All of it outdoors, in the Caribbean sun, steps from the pools.

## The Indoor Game Room

When the group wants to be inside — an evening in, a rainy afternoon, or the post-dinner wind-down — the indoor game room is stocked with card games and a collection of board games. That includes favorites popular across America, plus board games enjoyed in the Southern Hemisphere, so there is something familiar for international groups too.

## Pool Games for the Kids

For families, the pools are more than a place to cool off. They come stocked with kids' pool games and a pool basketball hoop, so younger guests have their own fun while the adults relax on the loungers. With two pools — a ground-level pool and a rooftop infinity pool — plus a 16-person hot tub, there is room for everyone to spread out.

## Two Hammocks for the Quiet Moments

Not every moment is a competition. Two hammocks are tucked into the grounds for the slow afternoons — a book, a nap, or watching the golfers roll by on Fairway 5.

## Beyond the Villa Gates

When the group wants to venture out, everything in Cap Cana is a short golf-cart ride away (the villa includes two 6-person carts):

- **Juanillo Beach** and **Eden Roc Beach Club** — about 8 minutes
- **El Dorado Water Park** — slides and a lazy river, a short ride
- **Scape Park** — zip lines, cenotes, and adventure, about 7 minutes
- **Cap Cana Marina** — the largest in the Caribbean, for sportfishing charters, catamaran trips, and sunset sails
- **Los Establos** — horseback riding, about 7 minutes
- **Rafa Nadal Tennis Center** — about 8 minutes

Your butler arranges any of it.

## Why This Matters for Your Group

The on-property recreation is what makes Villa Espada work for mixed groups — golfers and non-golfers, adults and kids, several generations under one roof. Nobody is stuck waiting on the golfers. Nobody runs out of things to do on a rest day. And because it is all on the property, the fun does not depend on booking anything or going anywhere.

For a golf group, it means more golf (that putting green) and better downtime. For a family, it means the trip works for everyone, not just the players.

## Plan Your Stay

Want to know more about what is on the property for your group? [Get in touch](https://www.espadavilla.com/contact) — tell us your group size and who is coming, and we will walk you through it. See the [full villa](https://www.espadavilla.com/villa) and [all amenities](https://www.espadavilla.com/amenities).
